description: February 11 birthday meaning: Aquarius decan 3, birthday number 11, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a February 11 birthday falls in Aquarius, in the third decan, with Uranus as the sign's ruler and Venus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 11. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Aquarius is fixed and air.

sections.heading: Personality of a February 11 birthday
paragraphs: Master number 11 is traditionally linked with intuition and inspiration, and on February 11 it meets the Venus-sub-ruled third decan of Aquarius, the Sun about twenty-two degrees in. Expect, interpretively, an idealistic and sensitive visionary: someone who picks up the mood of a room quickly and imagines how things could feel kinder.

By noon UTC on February 11, the Sun has normally reached roughly 22° of Aquarius. That places the date in the Aquarius decan that astrologers give to Venus, the third of three. Venus, ruler of Libra, softens the closing decan of Aquarius, from about February 9 to February 18. The sign's humanitarian streak picks up warmth, charm and a strong sense of fairness. Mid-February birthdays are often described as friendly idealists who care about justice as much as innovation and enjoy art, design and collaboration. Relationships tend to be valued as partnerships of equals. Venus can make them keen to keep the peace even when a principle is at stake. When this decan pairs its vision with its natural grace, it can make change feel welcoming rather than disruptive.

sections.heading: Numerology of the February 11 birthday
paragraphs: Born on the 11th, you have a birthday number of 11, and because it is a master number it stays unreduced. The day of birth is a secondary number in numerology, yet master numbers are traditionally given extra weight wherever they appear. Two 1s side by side suggest doubled sensitivity as well as doubled initiative: the 11 is linked with intuition, inspiration and a nervous, creative charge. Those born on this date are often described as idealistic and perceptive, sometimes picking up on things before they can explain why. Grounding routines and trusted company tend to help them carry that intensity comfortably.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same February 11 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 22 for 1980, 5 for 1990, 6 for 2000 and 7 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: February 11 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: February birthdays land in late winter for the northern hemisphere, when the light is visibly returning, and in late summer for the southern. The month moves from Aquarius into Pisces around February 18 or 19, from airy idealism to watery imagination. February is month 2 in numerology, a number of partnership, tact and sensitivity, which tends to give these birthdays a cooperative, quietly perceptive undertone. February 11 is the 42nd day of the year. In most years Pisces season is under way by February 19, 8 days after this birthday.

February 11 is a date where the Chinese animal genuinely depends on the year. Lunar New Year had arrived by this date in 88 of 121 years between 1924 and 2044; in the others the birth belongs to the previous animal. February 11 is also the birthday of Thomas Edison (1847), Jennifer Aniston (1969) and Taylor Lautner (1992).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is February 11?
faq.answer: February 11 is Aquarius in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Aquarius, which tradition links with Venus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on February 11?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On February 11 the Life Path is 2 in 1960, 3 in 1970, 22 in 1980, 5 in 1990, 6 in 2000, 7 in 2010 and 8 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 11 for everyone born on the 11th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on February 11?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology needs care here, because Lunar New Year moves between January 21 and February 20. Across 1924 to 2044 it had passed by February 11 in 88 of 121 years, so the year page for your birth year settles it.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on February 11?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a February 11 birthday are Thomas Edison (1847), Jennifer Aniston (1969) and Taylor Lautner (1992). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
